assumptions.name: Trust in Automation
assumptions.reason: Only Priya and Sofia can say how they know their automation works; six cannot verify anything beyond 'the balance goes up', and three require a named human for accountability.

assumptions.name: Switching Friction / ACATS
assumptions.reason: All ten said nothing mechanical is stopping their stranded asset. The binding constraint is the absence of a deadline, not the presence of friction.

assumptions.name: Primary Pain of Opaque Fees and Jargon
assumptions.reason: Zero subjects ranked fees first in Q3. Fees function as a purchase veto or are absent entirely, and one subject finds jargon reassuring.

assumptions.name: Tax Optimization Value
assumptions.reason: Only Priya and Sofia have both a securities tax surface and a workaround. Seven have no reachable surface, no awareness of one, or complexity beyond automation's scope.

assumptions.name: Pricing and 25 bps Value Capture
assumptions.reason: $96 flat is broadly acceptable but only 1 of 10 would actually pay 25 bps and 4 of 10 pay nothing at either price; no subject validated both halves of the assumption.

assumptions.name: Onboarding Autonomy
assumptions.reason: Five fail at the account-linking step: two hard refusals, one structural inability to authorise a spouse's accounts, one supervision requirement, one liability and incumbent-advisor gate.

assumptions.name: Decision-Making Unit / Spousal Co-approver
assumptions.reason: Five have a real, exercised veto with a standing venue and the co-approver's question is institutional legitimacy rather than price; caveat, the sample was built with four to five co-approvers so the result is partly designed in.

objections.objection: Absence of a forcing function: nothing mechanical blocks the move and nothing makes it happen
Account linking is an obstacle: hard refusal, structural inability, supervision requirement or disclosure checklist
Percentage-of-assets pricing rejected or attacked on structure, not amount
Basis points is an illegible unit; flat is a number I can say out loud
No reachable tax surface, or complexity beyond automation's scope
The product does not address the subject's own top-ranked problem
$96 flat signals low capability or non-viability
The incumbent is good enough: what exactly am I fixing
A named accountable human is required or wanted
Institutional legitimacy and custody: who are they and what happens if they go under
Household co-approval threshold of roughly $300 to $500 turns the purchase into a meeting that does not happen
Peer or social proof required before purchase
Partial migration only: trial-sized deposit, shadow mode or a dashboard with a hole in it
The incentive-alignment pitch lands as nothing, or as a competitor badmouthing the incumbent
The quoted 25 bps was computed on assets the provider cannot capture
The flat fee will be raised, tiered, or turned into a percentage later
Undisclosed revenue behind the flat fee: cash-sweep spread, securities lending, order flow or data
A flat fee is a cancellable card charge and therefore a churn risk a percentage does not have
Methodology and rigour repel rather than reassure; a published methodology document is a disqualifier

key_quotes.subject: Daniel Okonkwo
key_quotes.quote: I don't know that it's working. I know that I haven't received an email telling me it's broken. Which is not the same thing.

key_quotes.subject: Wes Tanaka
key_quotes.quote: Nothing's stopped it. Nothing's started it. Those are different sentences and yours assumed the first one.

key_quotes.subject: Sofia Marchetti
key_quotes.quote: Fees aren't a job I want handed off. Fees are the filter I use to decide who I'd hand anything to. You asked me what work I want done; fees aren't work, they're the price of the work. So: not the pain. Absolutely the veto.

key_quotes.subject: Brandon Ruiz
key_quotes.quote: Ninety-six percent of my money lives somewhere the tax code doesn't reach until I'm sixty-five.

key_quotes.subject: Sofia Marchetti
key_quotes.quote: It isn't the money. It's that you'd be charging me more each year for the same computation, and the mechanism by which your revenue grows is my savings rate. I would be paying you a royalty on my own discipline.

key_quotes.subject: Anika Deshmukh
key_quotes.quote: I was completely willing. Zero security objection. I'd link everything of mine tomorrow, read-only, without reading the terms. And the product still fails, because the accounts that would make it worth having are not mine to give.

key_quotes.subject: Marcus Webb
key_quotes.quote: I'm not the hard sell here, my wife is, and her first question won't be about fees. It'll be 'who are they and what happens if they go under.' If I can't answer that in two sentences at dinner, this doesn't happen, no matter how good the tax thing is.
